2.w: “How you have helped the powerless! How you have saved the person who has no strength!

3.w: How you have advised the one without wisdom, and abundantly revealed your insight!

4.w: To whom did you utter these words? And whose spirit has come forth from your mouth?

5.w: “The dead tremble — those beneath the waters and all that live in them.

6.w: The underworld is naked before God; the place of destruction lies uncovered.

7.w: He spreads out the northern skies over empty space; he suspends the earth on nothing.

8.w: He locks the waters in his clouds, and the clouds do not burst with the weight of them.

9.w: He conceals the face of the full moon, shrouding it with his clouds.

10.w: He marks out the horizon on the surface of the waters as a boundary between light and darkness.

11.w: The pillars of the heavens tremble and are amazed at his rebuke.

12.w: By his power he stills the sea; by his wisdom he cut Rahab the great sea monster to pieces.

13.w: By his breath the skies became fair; his hand pierced the fleeing serpent.

14.w: Indeed, these are but the outer fringes of his ways! How faint is the whisper we hear of him! But who can understand the thunder of his power?”
